assertions.title: API client authenticates with bearer token

steps.expected: App prompts for bearer token before protected API calls
steps.observed: Browser prompt dialog appeared with message 'Enter dashboard bearer token'.

steps.action: Dismiss token prompt and observe first protected request
steps.observed: GET /api/admin/workspace/entries?path=. returned 401 with no Authorization header.

steps.action: Repeat with prompt accepted as change-me
steps.expected: Protected request includes Authorization: Bearer header and succeeds
steps.observed: GET /api/admin/workspace/entries?path=. returned 200 with Authorization: Bearer change-me.

evidence.consoleErrors: none in prompt-accepted flow; expected 401 resource error appears only when prompt is dismissed during unauthenticated probe
evidence.network: Unauthenticated: GET /api/admin/workspace/entries?path=. -> 401 (no Authorization). Authenticated: GET /api/admin/workspace/entries?path=. -> 200 (Authorization: Bearer change-me).

assertions.title: Layout shell structure

steps.expected: Header + nav sidebar + main content + inspector panel all visible
steps.observed: All four zones are visible on desktop; header title/status, nav sidebar, main content, and inspector panel are present.

steps.expected: Sidebar/inspector can collapse and pane resizers support drag-to-resize
steps.observed: Sidebar collapse works; inspector resize drag works. Inspector collapsed-state toggle was not observed in this run.

steps.expected: Nav collapses and inspector switches to drawer mode with mobile triggers
steps.observed: Desktop nav remained visible; no mobile nav trigger and no inspector drawer trigger appeared.

assertions.issues: Narrow-screen collapse/drawer behavior required by contract was not observable on http://localhost:8081/dashboard during this rerun.

frictions.description: agent-browser could not launch due missing libnspr4.so in this environment.
frictions.resolution: Applied mission guidance fallback and executed browser automation with Playwright + LD_LIBRARY_PATH using bundled playwright libs.

frictions.description: Contract evidence example references GET /api/admin/status, but rerun surface emitted auth-relevant requests on /api/admin/workspace/entries for tested flows.
frictions.resolution: Captured equivalent protected endpoint request/response/auth-header evidence from live UI flow.

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 1 passed (VAL-REACT-FND-003) and 1 failed (VAL-REACT-FND-004: narrow-screen nav collapse/inspector drawer behavior not observed).
